description: Geförderte Photovoltaikanlagen Standorte Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.wien.gv.at. The map shows the distribution of all photovoltaic systems supported in the context of green electricity support in the city area of Vienna, supplemented by information on their performance and the date of construction. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Subsidised photovoltaic systems locations Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ViennaGIS, Sonnenenergie, Photovoltaik, Energiebericht Wien, Kollektoren. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, JPEG, WMS, KMZ. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
